description: This file defines the Response class in the Laminas\Diactoros namespace, implementing the PSR-7 ResponseInterface. It encapsulates HTTP response data, including status code, reason phrase, headers, and body stream, and provides methods for creating and manipulating response objects.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an immutable HTTP response message with status, headers, and body stream, conforming to PSR-7 ResponseInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Response object with a body stream, status code, and headers.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP status code.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the status code.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new Response instance with the specified status code and optional reason phrase.
